item.title: Six distressed Filipino seafarers repatriated from Suriname, receive government aid
item.description: Six Filipino seafarers who reported enduring inhumane working conditions and more than two months of unpaid wages were safely repatriated to the Philippines from Suriname, arriving at NAIA Terminal 3 on the evening of Friday, December 26, 2025. item.title: UAE weather alert: NCM issues safety guidelines amid dusty conditions
item.description: The National Center of Meteorology (NCM) has issued a public advisory urging residents across the UAE to take precautionary measures during dusty weather conditions, following a yellow dust alert issued on December 28. item.title: Dubai court voids luxury car sale, orders Dh600,000 refund after Interpol alert
item.description: A Dubai civil court has annulled a luxury vehicle sales contract and ordered a car dealership to refund Dh600,000 to a buyer after it was proven that the vehicle was internationally wanted by Interpol, making the transaction unlawful. The case stemmed from a lawsuit filed by an Arab national who purchased a used 2023 Mercedes-Benz …

item.title: 54% of Filipinos support immediate ban on political dynasties — survey
item.description: Fifty-four percent of Filipino adults surveyed agree that Congress should immediately pass a law banning political dynasties, according to the latest Pulse Asia Research poll.
